title: Authentic Taqueria-Style Mexican Rice and Pinto/Black Beans
originalTitle: Authentic Taqueria-Style Mexican Rice and Pinto/Black Beans
ingredients: Mexican Rice: 1.5 cups long-grain white rice, rinsed and dried
3 Roma tomatoes + 1/4 white onion + 2 cloves garlic (blended into smooth tomato purée)
2 tbsp neutral oil, 1 tsp cumin, 1 whole jalapeño or serrano, salt, and fresh cilantro
Mexican Beans: 2 cans (15 oz) pinto or black beans (with liquid)
2 tbsp bacon fat, lard, or olive oil + 1/2 finely diced onion + 2 cloves garlic
1/2 tsp oregano, 1/2 tsp cumin, cotija cheese, and pickled jalapeños
instructions: Make the Mexican Rice: Toast the rinsed, dried white rice in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5–6 minutes, stirring constantly until golden and nutty.

Pour the blended fresh tomato-onion-garlic purée into the toasted rice and fry for 2 minutes until deepened in color. Stir in broth, cumin, salt, and whole jalapeño; cover and simmer on low for 18 minutes, then rest 10 minutes covered.
Make the Mexican Beans: Sauté diced onion and garlic in oil/drippings for 5 minutes until caramelized. Pour in the pinto or black beans with their liquid, cumin, and oregano.
Simmer the beans for 15 minutes, mashing about a third of the beans with a potato masher for a creamy restaurant texture. Top with cotija cheese and cilantro.
